tagline: Schedule network PDF printing and email delivery.
description: PrintScheduler runs continuously on ZimaOS, schedules PDF jobs for network printers through CUPS, sends PDFs by SMTP, stores reusable email recipients and keeps its data in a persistent host directory. A bundled WUD service watches the mutable latest image digest and automatically recreates PrintScheduler when a new image is published.
author: pietrus06
title: PrintScheduler
release_note: Initial ZimaOS store release with automatic image digest updates.
